# Experimental VA observer pause/retain (offline)

**AI disclosure:** Generated by AI.

Partial implementation for [companion #95](https://github.com/iconidentify/omarchy-m1-video/issues/95).
Parent [#82](https://github.com/iconidentify/omarchy-m1-video/issues/82) and
[driver #42](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/42) stay open.
No hardware, no production-default merge, no live mapping.

```sh
python3 experiments/hevc-reference-content/va-adapter/tests.py
```

Needs Linux C compiler, patch, pkg-config libva, and network to fetch the pinned
driver archive. The test applies `driver-observer.patch` to
`c77e7b566f7baf9c7a2aad797e62c9aa578d9687`, compiles **actual** `src/decode.c`,
and links a **named fake V4L2** `ioctl`/`poll` backend. It is not a toy queue and
not an extracted-predicate-only harness.
